title: An Adaptive Framework for Robust Structural Shape Optimization under Uncertainty
summary: This work presents an adaptive framework for solving a robust structural shape optimization problem governed by linear elasticity with uncertain loading and material parameters. A posteriori error estimators are constructed to control the sample size, mesh resolution, and optimization step length. The sample size used in the stochastic gradient approximation is adjusted dynamically according to the variance of the sampled shape derivatives.
